questions.text: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Щоденна дія — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) going — немає допоміжного дієслова; В) go — бракує закінчення -es; Г) is going — Continuous не для щоденної звички.
✅ Б) goes — Present Simple, 3-тя особа однини: -es.

questions.text: Look! The children ___ in the garden now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Сигнали now/Look! — Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) played — минулий час не підходить; Б) play — Simple не для дії в момент мовлення; Г) plays — однина не узгоджується з children.
✅ В) are playing — Present Continuous: Look!, now.

questions.text: I ___ my homework yesterday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Yesterday — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) doing — немає допоміжного дієслова; В) have done — Perfect не вживається з yesterday; Г) do — теперішній час.
✅ Б) did — Past Simple, указано yesterday.

questions.text: We ___ to the cinema last Friday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last Friday — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) goes — однина і теперішній час; Б) go — теперішній час; Г) have gone — Perfect не вживається з last Friday.
✅ В) went — Past Simple від go.

questions.text: My brother ___ English very well.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Навичка — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) speak — бракує -s; В) speaking — немає допоміжного дієслова; Г) is speaking — Continuous не для постійної навички.
✅ Б) speaks — Present Simple, 3-тя особа однини.

questions.text: They ___ in London in 2015.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Рік у минулому — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) live — теперішній час; В) have lived — Perfect не вживається з 2015; Г) are living — Continuous не для завершеного минулого.
✅ Б) lived — Past Simple, указано рік.

questions.text: He ___ TV when I came in.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: When I came in — перерваний процес.
❌ Хибні: А) has watched — Perfect не поєднується з came; Б) watches — теперішній час; Г) watched — Simple не показує тривалості.
✅ В) was watching — Past Continuous: дія в процесі в момент іншої.

questions.text: I have never ___ sushi.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Have + третя форма.
❌ Хибні: Б) eat — V1 після have неправильна; В) ate — V2 після have неправильна; Г) eating — V-ing після have never неправильна.
✅ А) eaten — Present Perfect: have + V3.

questions.text: She ___ her keys, so she can't open the door.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Наслідок у теперішньому — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) lost — Simple без зв'язку з теперішнім; Б) is losing — Continuous не підходить; Г) loses — Simple для звички.
✅ В) has lost — Present Perfect: результат зараз.

questions.text: Tomorrow I ___ my grandmother.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Tomorrow — майбутнє.
❌ Хибні: А) visit — Simple без will; В) have visited — Perfect не підходить; Г) visited — минулий час.
✅ Б) will visit — майбутня дія, Future Simple.

questions.text: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Факти — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) is boiling — Continuous не для фактів; В) has boiled — Perfect не для фактів; Г) boiled — минулий час.
✅ Б) boils — наукова істина, Present Simple.

questions.text: We ___ dinner at 7 p.m. every evening.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Every evening — звичка.
❌ Хибні: А) are having — Continuous для моменту; Б) will have — майбутній час; Г) had — минулий час.
✅ В) have — Present Simple для звички.

questions.text: Peter ___ a new car last month.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last month — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) is buying — Continuous не для завершеної дії; Б) buys — теперішній час; В) has bought — Perfect не вживається з last month.
✅ Г) bought — Past Simple від buy.

questions.text: Does she ___ coffee?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Does + V1.
❌ Хибні: А) to like — після does без to; В) liking — після does — інфінітив; Г) likes — після does не потрібне -s.
✅ Б) like — після does — інфінітив без to.

questions.text: I ___ not go to the party last night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Did not + V1.
❌ Хибні: Б) do — теперішній час; В) was — з go не вживається; Г) have — Perfect не з last night.
✅ А) did — допоміжне дієслово Past Simple.

questions.text: There ___ a lot of people in the park yesterday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: People — множина, yesterday — минуле.
❌ Хибні: Б) was — однина; В) is — теперішній час; Г) are — теперішній час.
✅ А) were — минулий час, множина.

questions.text: He is the tallest boy. He ___ basketball every Sunday.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Every Sunday — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) has played — Perfect не для звички; Б) is playing — Continuous для моменту; В) played — минулий час.
✅ Г) plays — Present Simple, звичка.

questions.text: I ___ you a letter next week.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Next week — майбутнє.
❌ Хибні: Б) was writing — Continuous не відповідає змісту; В) have written — Perfect; Г) wrote — Past Simple.
✅ А) will write — Future Simple, обіцянка.

questions.text: What ___ you doing at 8 o'clock yesterday?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: At 8 yesterday — Past Continuous.
❌ Хибні: Б) was — не узгоджується з you; В) do — не для Continuous; Г) are — теперішній час.
✅ А) were — Past Continuous, множина.

questions.text: My parents ___ married for twenty years.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For + період — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) were — Past Simple не з for у сенсі «досі»; В) was — однина; Г) are — Simple не з for twenty years.
✅ Б) have been — Present Perfect з for.

questions.text: She ___ in this company since 2018.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Since — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) is working — Continuous не для тривалості з since; Б) works — Simple не з since; В) worked — Past Simple без зв'язку з теперішнім.
✅ Г) has worked — Present Perfect з since.

questions.text: It ___ now, so take an umbrella.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Now — Continuous.
❌ Хибні: Б) rained — минулий час; В) has rained — Perfect не підходить; Г) rains — Simple для звички.
✅ А) is raining — Present Continuous.

questions.text: I usually ___ up at 7 a.m.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Usually — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) am getting — Continuous не з usually; Б) getting — немає допоміжного; Г) got — минулий час.
✅ В) get — Present Simple з usually.

questions.text: He ___ to Kyiv two days ago.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Ago — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) has gone — Perfect не з ago; В) is going — Continuous; Г) goes — теперішній час.
✅ Б) went — Past Simple, ago.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Заперечення — doesn't + V1.
❌ Хибні: А) She don't like tea. — don't не з she; Б) She doesn't likes tea. — після doesn't -s не потрібне; В) She not like tea. — немає допоміжного.
✅ Г) She doesn't like tea. — does not + V1.

questions.text: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Питання — Did + підмет + V1.
❌ Хибні: А) Did you saw him yesterday? — після did — V1; Б) Do you saw him yesterday? — Do з минулим; Г) You did see him? — порушено порядок питання.
✅ В) Did you see him yesterday? — Did + V1.

questions.text: She enjoys ___ books.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: enjoy + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: А) read — після enjoy не V1; Б) to read — після enjoy не to-інфінітив; Г) reads — не герундій.
✅ В) reading — після enjoy — герундій.

questions.text: He wants ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: want + to V.
❌ Хибні: Б) became — минулий час; В) become — після want потрібне to; Г) becoming — після want не герундій.
✅ А) to become — після want — to-інфінітив.

questions.text: They decided ___ home.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: decide + to V.
❌ Хибні: А) going — після decide не герундій; В) go — потрібне to; Г) went — минулий час.
✅ Б) to go — після decide — to-інфінітив.

questions.text: We are looking forward to ___ you.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Look forward to + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: А) saw — минулий час; Б) to see — після look forward to — V-ing; В) see — прийменник to + V-ing.
✅ Г) seeing — після to (прийменник) — V-ing.

questions.text: I can ___ the piano.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Can + V1.
❌ Хибні: Б) playing — після can не V-ing; В) to play — після can без to; Г) plays — після can без -s.
✅ А) play — після can — V1.

questions.text: You must ___ your teacher.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Must + V1.
❌ Хибні: Б) listens to — після must без -s; В) to listen to — після must без to; Г) listening to — після must не V-ing.
✅ А) listen to — після must — V1.

questions.text: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: First conditional.
❌ Хибні: Б) stayed — минулий час; В) would stay — умовний II тип; Г) had stayed — умовний III тип.
✅ А) will stay — умовний I тип: if + Present, will + V.

questions.text: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Факт — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) is rising — Continuous для моменту; Б) rose — минулий час; Г) has risen — Perfect.
✅ В) rises — факт, Present Simple.

questions.text: My sister ___ to music now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Now — Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) listens — Simple для звички; В) has listened — Perfect; Г) listened — минулий час.
✅ Б) is listening — Present Continuous.

questions.text: He ___ his lunch an hour ago.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Ago — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) is having — Continuous; В) has — теперішній час; Г) has had — Perfect не з ago.
✅ Б) had — Past Simple, ago.

questions.text: We ___ in Lviv for three years.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For three years — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) are living — Continuous; Б) lived — Past Simple без зв'язку; В) live — Simple не з for three years.
✅ Г) have lived — Present Perfect з for.

questions.text: Have you ___ your room yet?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Yet — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: Б) cleaning — V-ing після have; В) clean — V1 після have; Г) clean to — неправильна форма.
✅ А) cleaned — Present Perfect: have + V3.

questions.text: When I was a child, I ___ in a village.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Минуле дитинство — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) am living — Continuous; В) live — теперішній час; Г) have lived — Perfect не з was a child.
✅ А) lived — Past Simple.

questions.text: The train ___ at 9 o'clock tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Розклад — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) has left — Perfect; Б) leaving — немає допоміжного дієслова; В) left — минулий час.
✅ Г) leaves — Present Simple для розкладу.

questions.text: She is afraid ___ dogs.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Afraid of something.
❌ Хибні: Б) in — неправильний прийменник; В) at — afraid at — неправильно; Г) to — afraid to + V1.
✅ А) of — afraid of + іменник.

questions.text: Water ___ at 0 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Факти — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) froze — минулий час; Б) is freezing — Continuous; В) has frozen — Perfect.
✅ Г) freezes — факт, Present Simple.

questions.text: Why ___ you late yesterday?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Yesterday — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) was — не з you; Б) have been — Perfect не з yesterday; В) are — теперішній час.
✅ Г) were — минулий час.

questions.text: He ___ his homework when his mother called.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: When + Past Simple перериває Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) did — Simple без тривалості; Б) does — теперішній час; В) has done — Perfect.
✅ Г) was doing — Past Continuous, дія перервана.

questions.text: I am sure he ___ you.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: I am sure + will.
❌ Хибні: А) has helped — Perfect; В) helps — Simple; Г) helped — минулий час.
✅ Б) will help — Future Simple, упевненість у прогнозі.

questions.text: Choose the correct form: "She ___ a book at the moment."
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: At the moment — Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) has read — Perfect; В) reads — Simple для звички; Г) read — минулий час.
✅ Б) is reading — at the moment — Continuous.

questions.text: Which sentence is in Present Perfect?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Present Perfect: have/has + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) I finish my work. — Present Simple; Б) I finished my work. — Past Simple; Г) I am finishing my work. — Present Continuous.
✅ В) I have finished my work. — have + V3.

questions.text: Choose the correct form: "My uncle ___ in Canada since 2010."
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Since + рік.
❌ Хибні: А) lived — Past Simple; Б) is living — Continuous; В) lives — Simple не з since.
✅ Г) has lived — since — Present Perfect.

questions.text: What ___ you do on Sundays?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Sundays — звичка.
❌ Хибні: А) are — не з do; Б) have — допоміжне для Perfect; Г) did — Past Simple.
✅ В) do — Present Simple для звички.

questions.text: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: By the time + Past Simple → Past Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) was starting — Continuous не про завершену дію; Б) has started — Perfect не з arrived; Г) started — Past Simple не показує, що раніше.
✅ В) had started — Past Perfect: дія раніше за іншу.

questions.text: I ___ him since last week.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Since last week — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) don't see — Present Simple не з since; В) didn't see — Past Simple не з since; Г) wasn't seeing — Continuous.
✅ Б) haven't seen — Present Perfect з since.

questions.text: When I came home, my mother ___ dinner.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Фон — Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) cooks — теперішній час; Б) has cooked — Perfect; Г) cooked — Simple не показує процес.
✅ В) was cooking — Past Continuous: процес.

questions.text: She said that she ___ the film before.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Reported speech: had + V3.
❌ Хибні: А) has seen — теперішній час; Б) sees — теперішній час; Г) saw — Simple не показує «раніше».
✅ В) had seen — Past Perfect у непрямій мові.

questions.text: I will call you as soon as I ___ home.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Після as soon as — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: Б) got — минулий час; В) will get — після as soon as не will; Г) am getting — Continuous.
✅ А) get — у підрядному часу майбутнього Present Simple.

questions.text: Don't phone me at 8. I ___ dinner then.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: О 8 у майбутньому — процес.
❌ Хибні: А) had — минулий час; Б) have had — Perfect не з майбутнім; Г) have — Simple.
✅ В) will be having — Future Continuous: процес о 8.

questions.text: He ___ for two hours when she arrived.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For two hours + when — P. P. Continuous.
❌ Хибні: Б) was waiting — не показує «вже дві години»; В) waited — Simple; Г) has been waiting — теперішній зв'язок.
✅ А) had been waiting — Past Perfect Continuous: тривалість до моменту.

questions.text: I ___ this film three times.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Three times — досвід.
❌ Хибні: А) was seeing — Continuous; В) see — Simple; Г) saw — Simple не для досвіду.
✅ Б) have seen — Present Perfect: досвід, кількість.

questions.text: She is very tired. She ___ all day.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: All day + результат — Perfect Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) works — Simple; Б) is working — Continuous; Г) worked — Simple.
✅ В) has been working — Present Perfect Continuous: тривалий процес.

questions.text: By next year, he ___ his studies.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: By next year — завершено до моменту.
❌ Хибні: Б) finished — Simple; В) finishes — Simple; Г) will finish — Future Simple.
✅ А) will have finished — Future Perfect.

questions.text: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Другий тип: If + were.
❌ Хибні: А) had been — умовний III тип; Б) be — неправильна форма; Г) am — нереальна умова потребує were.
✅ В) were — умовний II тип: were для всіх осіб.

questions.text: I wish I ___ more free time.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Wish + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) have — теперішня форма; В) will have — майбутнє; Г) would have — неправильна форма.
✅ Б) had — wish + Past Simple: бажання, нереальне зараз.

questions.text: She suggested ___ to the cinema.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Suggest + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: Б) go — потрібне V-ing; В) to go — після suggest не to V; Г) went — минулий час.
✅ А) going — suggest + V-ing.

questions.text: He avoided ___ the question.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Avoid + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: А) answered — минулий час; В) to answer — після avoid не to V; Г) answer — потрібне V-ing.
✅ Б) answering — avoid + V-ing.

questions.text: I forgot ___ the door, so the cat got out.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Forget to V — забути зробити.
❌ Хибні: Б) locked — минулий час; В) lock — потрібен to-інфінітив; Г) locking — забув про минуле.
✅ А) to lock — забув виконати дію.

questions.text: I remember ___ him at the party last year.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Remember V-ing — спогад.
❌ Хибні: А) to meet — пам'ятати зробити в майбутньому; В) meet — потрібен герундій; Г) met — минулий час.
✅ Б) meeting — remember + V-ing — пам'ятаю, що зробив.

questions.text: She stopped ___ when she saw the police.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Stop V-ing — припинити.
❌ Хибні: А) run — потрібен герундій; Б) ran — минулий час; В) to run — зупинилася, щоб бігти.
✅ Г) running — перестала бігти.

questions.text: He used to ___ football in his youth.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Used to + V1.
❌ Хибні: Б) playing — після used to — V1; В) plays — без -s; Г) played — використовується одна форма.
✅ А) play — used to + V1: давня звичка.

questions.text: I am used to ___ up early.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Be used to + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: А) to get — неправильна конструкція; Б) got — минулий час; В) get — після be used to — V-ing.
✅ Г) getting — be used to + V-ing: звикнути.

questions.text: It's high time we ___ home.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: It's time + Past.
❌ Хибні: А) are going — Continuous; Б) will go — майбутнє; Г) go — теперішня форма.
✅ В) went — It's high time + Past Simple.

questions.text: She is the woman who ___ next door.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Who + 3-тя особа.
❌ Хибні: Б) live — бракує -s; В) is live — неправильно; Г) living — герундій.
✅ А) lives — Present Simple, підмет who.

questions.text: I ___ him two years ago.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Ago — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) was meeting — Continuous; Б) meet — теперішній час; В) have met — Perfect не з ago.
✅ Г) met — Past Simple, ago.

questions.text: He has already ___ the letter.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Already + has V3.
❌ Хибні: А) wrote — V2 після has; В) writing — V-ing після has; Г) write — V1 після has.
✅ Б) written — Present Perfect: V3.

questions.text: When ___ you last see him?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Last + минулий час.
❌ Хибні: А) were — не підходить; Б) have — Perfect не з last; В) do — теперішній час.
✅ Г) did — Past Simple запитання.

questions.text: We ___ to the sea every summer when we were kids.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: When we were kids — минуле.
❌ Хибні: А) have gone — Perfect; Б) go — теперішній час; Г) are going — Continuous.
✅ В) went — Past Simple, повторювана дія.

questions.text: He ___ the news when the phone rang.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Фонова дія.
❌ Хибні: А) read — Simple; Б) has read — Perfect; В) reads — Present.
✅ Г) was reading — Past Continuous.

questions.text: She works hard because she ___ to pass the exam.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Want не вживається в Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) wanted — минулий час; Б) has wanted — Perfect; Г) is wanting — want — стативне.
✅ В) wants — Present Simple, дієслово стану.

questions.text: I ___ him since he was a child.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Know не вживається в Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) know — Simple не з since; Б) knew — Past Simple; В) am knowing — know не в Continuous.
✅ Г) have known — Present Perfect, know — стативне.

questions.text: This soup ___ delicious.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Taste = мати смак.
❌ Хибні: А) tasted — минулий час; В) has tasted — Perfect; Г) is tasting — taste у цьому значенні — стативне.
✅ Б) tastes — стативне дієслово у Simple.

questions.text: I ___ for you for an hour. Where have you been?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For an hour + зараз — Perfect Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) wait — Simple; В) waited — Simple; Г) was waiting — Past Continuous.
✅ Б) have been waiting — Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.text: Tomorrow at this time we ___ on the beach.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Tomorrow at this time — процес.
❌ Хибні: А) have lain — Perfect; Б) lie — Simple; Г) lay — минулий час.
✅ В) will be lying — Future Continuous.

questions.text: They ___ already left when we got there.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Already + left раніше.
❌ Хибні: А) were — неправильна форма; Б) would — модальне; Г) have — Present Perfect не з got.
✅ В) had — Past Perfect: had left.

questions.text: I'm tired because I ___ since 5 a.m.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Since 5 a.m. — тривалість до зараз.
❌ Хибні: А) worked — Simple; Б) am working — Continuous; В) work — Simple.
✅ Г) have been working — Perfect Continuous з since.

questions.text: He asked me where I ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Reported question.
❌ Хибні: А) do live — неправильний порядок; В) live — теперішній час; Г) did live — зайве допоміжне.
✅ Б) lived — непряме питання: Past Simple.

questions.text: She told us she ___ the next day.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Reported speech: would.
❌ Хибні: Б) will come — теперішній прогноз; В) comes — Simple; Г) came — Past Simple не про майбутнє.
✅ А) would come — Future in the Past.

questions.text: The more you practise, the ___ you become.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Comparative the…the.
❌ Хибні: Б) good — неправильна форма; В) well — прислівник; Г) best — найвищий ступінь.
✅ А) better — the more… the better.

questions.text: If he had studied harder, he ___ the exam.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Third conditional.
❌ Хибні: Б) had passed — не для результату; В) would pass — другий тип; Г) will pass — перший тип.
✅ А) would have passed — третій тип.

questions.text: By the end of the week, I ___ the report.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: By the end of — завершено.
❌ Хибні: А) write — Present; В) wrote — Past; Г) will write — Future Simple.
✅ Б) will have written — Future Perfect.

questions.text: The meeting ___ at 5 p.m. tomorrow (timetable).
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Розклад — Present Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) has started — Perfect; Б) started — минулий час; В) is starting yesterday — неприродна форма.
✅ Г) starts — Present Simple для розкладу.

questions.text: We ___ never ___ such a beautiful place before.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Before у минулому — Past Perfect.
❌ Хибні: Б) have; seen — Present Perfect не з before у минулому; В) were; seeing — Continuous; Г) did; see — Past Simple не з before.
✅ А) had; seen — Past Perfect: before у минулому.

questions.text: My dog ___ every morning.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Every morning — Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) is barking — Continuous не для щоденної дії; Б) barking — немає допоміжного; В) barked — минулий час.
✅ Г) barks — Present Simple, звичка.

questions.text: It's the first time I ___ sushi.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: First time → Present Perfect.
❌ Хибні: Б) am eating — Continuous; В) eat — Present Simple; Г) ate — Simple не тут.
✅ А) have eaten — It's the first time + Present Perfect.

questions.text: No sooner ___ home than it started to rain.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: No sooner + had + підмет.
❌ Хибні: А) did I get — Past Simple не тут; Б) I had got — порядок слів без інверсії; Г) I got — Simple без інверсії.
✅ В) had I got — No sooner + Past Perfect з інверсією.

questions.text: I'd rather you ___ here.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would rather + Past.
❌ Хибні: Б) don't smoke — теперішній час; В) won't smoke — майбутній; Г) haven't smoked — Perfect.
✅ А) didn't smoke — would rather + підмет + Past Simple.

questions.text: He looks as if he ___ a ghost.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: As if — нереальність.
❌ Хибні: А) will see — майбутнє; В) sees — Simple; Г) has seen — теперішній час.
✅ Б) had seen — as if + Past Perfect: нереальне минуле.

questions.text: She works as a nurse. She ___ in this hospital for ten years.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For ten years — Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) works — Simple; В) worked — Simple; Г) is working — Continuous.
✅ Б) has worked — Present Perfect з for.

questions.text: Please be quiet! The baby ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Дія зараз.
❌ Хибні: Б) has slept — Perfect; В) sleeps — Simple для звички; Г) slept — минулий час.
✅ А) is sleeping — Present Continuous.

questions.text: If she ___ the bus, she would have been on time.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Third conditional.
❌ Хибні: А) wouldn't miss — would не після if; Б) doesn't miss — перший тип; Г) didn't miss — другий тип.
✅ В) hadn't missed — третій тип: Past Perfect.

questions.text: They ___ a new house next year.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Next year + намір.
❌ Хибні: Б) built — минулий час; В) build — Simple без розкладу; Г) have built — Perfect.
✅ А) are going to build — намір.

questions.text: While I ___ the dishes, the phone rang.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: While — Continuous.
❌ Хибні: Б) washed — Simple; В) have washed — Perfect; Г) wash — Simple.
✅ А) was washing — Past Continuous: while.

questions.text: Hardly ___ the announcement when the audience began to leave.
questions.explanation:
💡 Hardly на початку речення вимагає інверсії та Past Perfect: Hardly had + підмет + V3 + when.
❌ А) звичайний порядок слів; В) did + V1 не передає попередню завершену дію; Г) немає інверсії.
✅ Б) had the speaker finished — правильна інверсія з Past Perfect.

questions.text: If Maya ___ the warning yesterday, she would not be dealing with this problem now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Це змішаний умовний тип: причина в минулому, наслідок тепер.
❌ Б) would take — не ставимо would в if-clause; В) would have taken — не відповідає теперішньому наслідку; Г) took — не показує нереальну минулу умову.
✅ А) had taken — Past Perfect у частині if.

questions.text: By the end of this semester, we ___ all the required experiments.
questions.explanation:
💡 By the end of this semester задає межу в майбутньому; потрібен Future Perfect.
❌ А) Future Simple не підкреслює завершення до межі; В) Present Continuous не підходить; Г) Present Perfect не вживається з майбутньою межею.
✅ Б) will have completed — will have + V3.

questions.text: She would rather you ___ the matter with anyone until the meeting.
questions.explanation:
💡 Would rather + інша особа + Past Simple виражає бажання щодо теперішнього або майбутнього.
❌ А) Present Simple; В) will після would rather тут не вживається; Г) інфінітивна конструкція неправильна.
✅ Б) didn't discuss — форма минулого часу має умовне, а не минуле значення.

questions.text: The manager denied ___ the confidential file to anyone outside the team.
questions.explanation:
💡 Deny вимагає герундія; having sent підкреслює дію, що відбулася раніше.
❌ А) deny не вживається з to-infinitive; В) to have sent — неправильна модель після deny; Г) потрібна форма -ing.
✅ Б) having sent — perfect gerund після denied.

questions.text: Not until the final page ___ that two paragraphs had been omitted.
questions.explanation:
💡 Not until на початку речення спричиняє інверсію в головній частині.
❌ А) і Г) немає інверсії; В) Past Perfect тут не потрібен.
✅ Б) did I notice — did + підмет + V1.

questions.text: The witness is believed ___ the building before the alarm went off.
questions.explanation:
💡 Після is believed вживаємо інфінітив; якщо дія сталася раніше за іншу минулу подію, потрібен Perfect Infinitive.
❌ А) звичайний інфінітив не показує попередність; В) герундій не підходить; Г) немає потрібної конструкції.
✅ Б) to have left — Perfect Infinitive.

questions.text: ___ by the sudden change in the schedule, several students missed the first lecture.
questions.explanation:
💡 Потрібен дієприкметниковий зворот у пасивному значенні: студенти були спантеличені.
❌ А) confusing описувало б те, що викликає плутанину; Б) having confused — активне значення; Г) інфінітив не утворює потрібний зворот.
✅ В) Confused — скорочений пасивний підрядний зворот.

questions.text: I wish I ___ the instructions more carefully before I submitted the form.
questions.explanation:
💡 Wish + Past Perfect виражає жаль щодо минулої ситуації.
❌ А) read може бути формою теперішнього або минулого, але тут потрібен Past Perfect; Б) would read — бажання щодо майбутньої поведінки; Г) Present Perfect не підходить.
✅ В) had read — жаль про те, чого не зробили раніше.

questions.text: The technician said that the system ___ automatically if the temperature exceeded the limit.
questions.explanation:
💡 У непрямій мові після said майбутнє зсувається в Future in the Past.
❌ А) не узгоджено з минулим звітуванням; В) Future Perfect не відповідає умові; Г) Present Perfect не підходить.
✅ Б) would shut down — відповідник will shut down у минулому контексті.

questions.text: If only I ___ the answer yesterday!
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If only + had V3.
❌ Хибні: Б) will know — Future; В) know — Present; Г) knew — нереальне теперішнє.
✅ А) had known — If only + Past Perfect: жаль про минуле.

questions.text: I wish I ___ to the party last night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Wish + had V3.
❌ Хибні: А) went — нереальне теперішнє; Б) go — Present; В) would go — майбутнє.
✅ Г) had gone — wish + Past Perfect: жаль про минуле.

questions.text: She looked tired. She ___ all night.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Причина стану в минулому.
❌ Хибні: Б) was working — Past Continuous; В) has been working — Perfect Continuous; Г) worked — Past Simple.
✅ А) had been working — Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.text: Suppose you ___ the lottery, what would you do?
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Suppose + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) will win — Future; Б) win — Present; Г) had won — Past Perfect.
✅ В) won — supposing + Past Simple: нереальна умова.

questions.text: It's about time they ___ attention.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: It's time + Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) pay — теперішній; В) have paid — Perfect; Г) will pay — майбутній.
✅ Б) paid — It's about time + Past Simple.

questions.text: He denied ___ the window.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Deny + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: А) broke — минулий час; Б) break — потрібне V-ing; В) to break — після deny не to V.
✅ Г) breaking — deny + V-ing.

questions.text: She promised ___ me.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Promise + to V.
❌ Хибні: Б) helping — після promise не V-ing; В) help — потрібне to; Г) helped — минулий час.
✅ А) to help — promise + to V.

questions.text: We can't afford ___ a new car.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Afford + to V.
❌ Хибні: Б) buying — після afford не V-ing; В) bought — минулий час; Г) buy — потрібне to.
✅ А) to buy — afford + to V.

questions.text: I can't stand ___ in queues.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Can't stand + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: Б) wait — потрібне V-ing; В) waited — минулий час; Г) to wait up — неприродно.
✅ А) waiting — can't stand + V-ing.

questions.text: He is said ___ in a small village.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Is said to V.
❌ Хибні: Б) lives — Simple не тут; В) living — не після is said; Г) live — потрібне to.
✅ А) to live — passive infinitive.

questions.text: She seems ___ a lot of experience.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Seem + to V.
❌ Хибні: А) have — потрібне to; Б) having — після seems не V-ing; Г) had — минулий час.
✅ В) to have — seem + to V.

questions.text: I would like ___ with you.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Would like + to V.
❌ Хибні: А) come — потрібне to; Б) coming — після would like не V-ing; В) came — минулий час.
✅ Г) to come — would like + to V.

questions.text: It's no use ___ about the past.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: It's no use + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: Б) to worry — після it's no use не to V; В) worried — минулий час; Г) worry — потрібне V-ing.
✅ А) worrying — it's no use + V-ing.

questions.text: She had no difficulty ___ the problem.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Have difficulty + V-ing.
❌ Хибні: Б) to solve — після difficulty не to V; В) solve — потрібне V-ing; Г) solved — минулий час.
✅ А) solving — have difficulty + V-ing.

questions.text: He made me ___ the room.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Make + об'єкт + V1.
❌ Хибні: А) cleaning — після make не V-ing; Б) to clean — після make без to; В) cleaned — минулий час.
✅ Г) clean — make sb do.

questions.text: The teacher let us ___ early.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Let + об'єкт + V1.
❌ Хибні: А) leaving — після let не V-ing; Б) left — минулий час; Г) to leave — після let без to.
✅ В) leave — let sb do.

questions.text: I'm looking forward ___ you next week.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Look forward to V-ing.
❌ Хибні: А) see — потрібен to + V-ing; Б) seeing — бракує to; Г) to see — після to-прийменника V-ing.
✅ В) to seeing — look forward to + V-ing.

questions.text: It is high time he ___ a job.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: It's high time + Past.
❌ Хибні: А) has found — Perfect; Б) finds — теперішній; В) will find — майбутній.
✅ Г) found — It is high time + Past Simple.

questions.text: By 2030, scientists ___ a cure for the disease.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: By 2030 — завершення до моменту.
❌ Хибні: А) found — Past; Б) will find — Future Simple; Г) find — Simple.
✅ В) will have found — Future Perfect.

questions.text: I ___ in the garden when I heard a strange noise.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Фонова дія + перервана.
❌ Хибні: А) have worked — Perfect; В) worked — Simple; Г) work — Simple.
✅ Б) was working — Past Continuous, перерване Simple.

questions.text: He ___ his leg while he was skiing.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Коротка дія — Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) breaks — Present; В) was breaking — Continuous не для короткої дії; Г) has broken — Perfect.
✅ Б) broke — Past Simple, коротка дія.

questions.text: When I got to the station, the train ___.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Раніше за got → Past Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) already left — Simple без had; В) was leaving already — неприродно; Г) has already left — Present Perfect.
✅ Б) had already left — Past Perfect: потяг поїхав раніше.

questions.text: Neither of the students ___ the answer.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Neither — однина.
❌ Хибні: А) are knowing — know — стативне; В) know — множина; Г) knowing — немає допоміжного.
✅ Б) knows — neither + однина.

questions.text: The police ___ looking for the thief.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Police + множина.
❌ Хибні: А) is — police завжди множина; Б) was — однина; Г) has — неправильна форма.
✅ В) are — police — збірне, множина.

questions.text: He ___ be at home; his car is outside.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Must be — упевнене припущення.
❌ Хибні: А) needn't — не про припущення; В) shouldn't — порада; Г) can't — протилежне значення.
✅ Б) must — припущення впевненості.

questions.text: She ___ have left yet; her coat is still here.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Can't have V3.
❌ Хибні: А) should — порада; Б) may — можливість; В) must — упевнене підтвердження.
✅ Г) can't — упевнене заперечення в минулому.

questions.text: You ___ have told me earlier! (criticism)
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Should have — докір.
❌ Хибні: А) must — висновок; Б) can — можливість; В) will — майбутнє.
✅ Г) should — should have V3 — докір.

questions.text: The company ___ since the start of this year.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Since the start — тривалість.
❌ Хибні: А) will expand — Future; В) expands — Simple; Г) expanded — Past.
✅ Б) has been expanding — Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.text: "Did you see her?" "Yes, I ___ her an hour ago."
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Ago — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) see — Simple; В) have seen — Perfect не з ago; Г) had seen — Past Perfect.
✅ Б) saw — Past Simple, ago.

questions.text: If he ___ harder, he would have a better job now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Mixed conditional.
❌ Хибні: А) worked — другий тип; В) will work — майбутнє; Г) works — перший тип.
✅ Б) had worked — змішаний тип: минуле → теперішнє.

questions.text: If I were rich, I ___ the world.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Second conditional.
❌ Хибні: А) will travel — перший тип; В) travelled — не would; Г) had travelled — третій тип.
✅ Б) would travel — другий тип.

questions.text: Unless you ___ now, you will miss the bus.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Unless + Present.
❌ Хибні: А) will leave — після unless не will; Б) are leaving not — неприродно; Г) left — Past.
✅ В) leave — unless + Present Simple.

questions.text: She ___ the same dress for three days.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: For three days — Perfect Continuous.
❌ Хибні: Б) will wear — Future; В) wore — Past; Г) wears — Simple.
✅ А) has been wearing — Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct (time expressions)?
options: I have been living here since 2015.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Since → Perfect (Continuous).
❌ Хибні: А) I lived here since 2015. — Past не з since; В) I am living here since 2015. — Continuous не з since; Г) I live here since 2015. — Simple не з since.
✅ Б) I have been living here since 2015. — Perfect Continuous з since.

questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct (sequence of events)?
options: By the time we arrived, they have left.
By the time we arrived, they had left.
By the time we arrived, they left.
By the time we arrived, they were left.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Раніше за arrived — Past Perfect.
❌ Хибні: А) By the time we arrived, they have left. — Perfect не з arrived; В) By the time we arrived, they left. — Simple не показує «раніше»; Г) By the time we arrived, they were left. — Passive не підходить.
✅ Б) By the time we arrived, they had left. — Past Perfect.

questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct (conditionals)?
options: If it will rain, we stay at home.
If it rained, we will stay at home.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
If it rains, we would stay at home.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If + Present, will V.
❌ Хибні: А) If it will rain, we stay at home. — will після if; Б) If it rained, we will stay at home. — змішано; Г) If it rains, we would stay at home. — would не з Present.
✅ В) If it rains, we will stay at home. — first conditional.

questions.text: The students ___ the exam when the fire alarm went off.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Фон — Continuous.
❌ Хибні: А) take — Present; Б) have taken — Perfect не з went off; Г) took — Simple не показує процес.
✅ В) were taking — Past Continuous: процес перервано.

questions.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean ___ you.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Mean to V — мати намір.
❌ Хибні: А) hurt — потрібне to; В) hurted — неправильна форма; Г) hurting — mean V-ing — означати.
✅ Б) to hurt — mean to V — мати намір.

questions.text: If you ___ me the truth, I wouldn't be angry now.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: If + had V3, would + V1.
❌ Хибні: Б) told — другий тип; В) will tell — Future; Г) tell — Present.
✅ А) had told — mixed conditional: минуле → теперішнє.

questions.text: The moment she ___ the news, she burst into tears.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Послідовні дії — Past Simple.
❌ Хибні: А) has heard — Perfect не в минулому; Б) had hearing — неправильна форма; В) was heard — Passive.
✅ Г) heard — Past Simple, послідовні дії.

questions.text: The company ___ over 500 people by the end of next year.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: By the end of next year — стан у майбутньому.
❌ Хибні: Б) has employed — Perfect; В) employs — Simple; Г) employed — Past.
✅ А) will be employing — Future Continuous: тривалий стан до моменту.

questions.text: He is thought ___ the country last year.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Is thought + have V3.
❌ Хибні: А) leaving — неправильна форма; Б) left — минулий час; Г) to leave — теперішня дія.
✅ В) to have left — perfect infinitive: дія в минулому.

questions.text: You'd better ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation:
💡 Пастка: Had better + V1.
❌ Хибні: А) to see — після had better без to; Б) saw — минулий час; Г) seeing — після had better не V-ing.
✅ В) see — had better + V1.

cards.question: Present Simple
cards.answer: Звички, факти, розклад. Закінчення -s/-es у 3-й особі однини: she works.

cards.question: Present Continuous
cards.answer: am/is/are + V-ing: дія в момент мовлення або тимчасова ситуація.

cards.question: Present Perfect
cards.answer: have/has + V3: результат зараз або досвід; сигнали: ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for.

cards.question: Past Simple
cards.answer: V2: завершена дія в минулому з указаним часом (yesterday, in 2010, ago).

cards.question: Past Continuous
cards.answer: was/were + V-ing: тривала дія в певний момент у минулому.

cards.question: Past Perfect
cards.answer: had + V3: дія, що відбулася раніше іншої минулої дії.

cards.question: Future Simple
cards.answer: will + V: спонтанне рішення, прогноз, обіцянка.

cards.question: be going to
cards.answer: Заплановані наміри та прогнози на основі видимих ознак.

cards.question: Gerund vs Infinitive
cards.answer: enjoy, avoid, suggest + V-ing; want, decide, hope + to V.

cards.question: Stative verbs
cards.answer: know, like, love, want, believe зазвичай не вживаються в Continuous.
